marta: Hey — need an ad-hoc export of audit logs for an internal bug investigation (INC-4321). Can someone confirm what columns we can get, redaction rules, and who can run it? Prefer CSV. Need last 30 days.

jamal: @eve pinged. From eng-sre: we can run exports but we need a ticket with justification. We use `audit-export` (infra-tools). By default exports are redacted. Example:
```
audit-export --from=2026-02-14 --to=2026-03-15 --format=csv --fields=ts,actor_id,action,resource,resource_id,ip,request_id,outcome,extra --redact=on
```
Expect ~10–30s per day for 30 days; can be bigger if extra fields selected.

eve: Security note: exports that might contain PII require approval. Two safe paths:
- Redacted export (default): hash `actor_id`, remove `actor_email`, mask IP (last octet zeroed), strip prompt/response content and tokens. No additional approval needed if you include INC ticket and scope.
- Full PII export: require Privacy + Sec approval, and only for lawful/urgent incidents.
Retention: hot audit logs available for 90 days; archive (365d) can be pulled but takes ~24h and Privacy approval.
Formats: CSV, NDJSON, Parquet supported. CSV headers we expose by default:
```
ts,actor_id,action,resource,resource_id,ip,region,request_id,outcome,details
```

jamal: To proceed: open a JIRA ticket (ENG-SEC-EXPORT) with INC-4321, time range, filters, and whether you accept redaction. If >90 days or need prompt text, mark as "Privacy-approval required". We will queue job once ticket is linked.

auditbot: export request received (job queued). placeholder id: job-2026-179701. Note: redaction=on

marta: Thanks — filing the ticket now and will request the redacted CSV for last 30 days. Will add filters: resource=audits-api, action=modify, actor=service-account-*.
